edits.old: It declares no column, no index, no migration and no bound on the review date: every list, code and rule is referenced with its identifier and its version.
edits.new: It declares no column, no index, no migration and no bound on the review date: every list, code and rule is referenced with its identifier and its version. The hold, its reason and its review date are carried in the local decision record and on the case of record; no column and no state name is declared in rwb_valuation, and the data owner and the P3 owner name them in a minor contract version (GAP-2638). The review date is a durable timer of RouteDecisionWorkflow on rwb-valuation; the lift move and the task answer come from rwb-case, and the P3 owner confirms the held state and the clock when FEAT-CWC-11 is published (GAP-2639). The hold reason and the review date are optional elements of the one route operation and no second operation is declared; the four consumed rows are built against their documented use with a placeholder operation name and a fake, and the placeholder is replaced in a minor contract version when an owner publishes a name (GAP-2641). The reason is a coded value of reference data read with its version; a code that is not in the list of the business date is refused with MSG-GEN-001, the review date carries no bound, and the catalog entry for the hold stays open until the data owner publishes it (GAP-2640).
